abstract: In an earlier article ("The Name Puzzle," AP-S Newsletter, vol. 25, p. 30, Dec. 1983) the author pointed out the structural differences of some 'foreign' names as compared with conventional American or British usage. This note continues with a discussion of Arab names and Arabic numerals. It is noted that most Arab names have three parts: the first part is the person's given-name; the second part is his father's given-name; and the third part is his grandfather's given-name.

abstract: This hidden word puzzle is heavily biased towards Electromagnetics. Following the usual technique, one crosses out within the grid all the words of a list given. These may appear vertically, horizontally or along diagonals, either from left to right or from right to left, either going upward or downwards. Four letters will then remain, indicating the site of a recent discovery in infrared astronomy, made by satellite IRAS-1.
